marks.gloss_en: ולגבהיה לאתרוג ולבריך! -- if height is the reason, let him raise the etrog higher and bless over it
אמר ליה: הואיל ובמינו גבוה מכולן -- it is the lulav's species (the palm) that is highest of all, not the held object (= p_zerika_bemino_gavoha)
Rabbah: the lulav in the right hand and the etrog in the left
by implication: if he dropped them [from the tube] himself -- fit
Rabbah: one should not insert the lulav into the hoshana, lest leaves fall off and interpose
Rabbah: one should not trim the lulav [while it is] in the hoshana, for shreds remain and interpose
Rabbah: it is forbidden to smell the mitzva myrtle
Rabbah: a myrtle while attached [to the ground] -- it is permitted to smell it
Beit Hillel: [the lulav is waved] at 'Give thanks to the Lord' at the beginning and the end, and at 'Lord, please save us'
זאת אומרת ... שהרי תנופה שירי מצוה היא ועוצרת רוחות וטללים רעים -- inferred from the memra that the waving halts harmful winds (and dews); kind svara because no support kind names זאת אומרת
R' Yochanan: he moves to and fro -- to Him whose are the four directions
any lulav that has three handbreadths, enough to wave with it, is fit
the two loaves and two lambs of Atzeret: he places the loaves on the lambs, puts his hand beneath them, waves -- moving to and fro, raising and lowering
